quotes.text: // The Message-ID of the message the MDN reply is for.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 483 gives m_messageId to the new MDN reply and m_originalMessageId to the message being acknowledged. Current generator puts the former in Message-ID and sendMailMessage, and the latter in References/Original-Message-ID. Mixing them can send an envelope ID different from the generated MIME header. This supports role-specific naming, not merely an m_ prefix rule.
title: Keep the MDN reply ID distinct from the original message ID
